import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

# --- huge compressed body via repeat definition, single request per chunk boundary
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'A'*1000*1000*1000"],["part","big[0:500]"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[
               {"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 1000000000\r\n\r\n"},
               {"case":"a","data":"{{big}}"},
               {"case":None,"data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 500\r\n\r\n"},
               {"case":None,"data":"{{part}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
ch = r['channels'][0]
print('   huge body time %.2fs' % dt)
check('huge body error', ch['error'], None)
check('huge body count', len(ch['requests']), 2)
check('huge body fp', ch['requests'][0]['body']['n'], 1000000000)
want = fp(b'A'*500)['h']
check('part body fp', ch['requests'][1]['body'], {'n':500,'h':want})
check('huge committed', ch['committed'], [0,1,1,2])

# --- many small requests across parts
parts=[]
req = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n'
for i in range(200):
    parts.append({"case":"a","data":req.decode()})
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":parts}])
t0=time.time(); r = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   200 requests %.2fs' % dt)
check('many requests', (len(r['channels'][0]['requests']), r['channels'][0]['error']), (200,None))
check('many committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [i for i in range(201)])
check('case extra_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['extra_origin'])

# --- chunk lines budget enforcement
chunked = b'Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n' + b'0\r\n\r\n'*20001
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n"+chunked.decode()}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('chunk line budget', r, {"error":"input"})

# --- request budget enforcement
many = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'*20001
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":many[:2000].decode()},{"case":None,"data":many[2000:].decode()}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('request budget', r, {"error":"input"})

# --- full scale batch: 2000 cases, 50000 frames/events/parts
cases=[]
for i in range(2000):
    frames=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/p%d"%i]]},
            {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":1},
            {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"body%d"%i,"End_Stream":True}]
    cases.append({"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/p%d"%i,"host":"h"}})
events=[{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":4*i,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True} for i in range(2000)]
parts=[]
req=b'GET /p HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nok'
for i in range(250):   # 25000 parts -> budget check below
    parts.append({"case":"c%d"%(i%2000),"data":req.decode()})
doc = base(cases=cases, events=events, channels=[{"name":"e%d"%i,"parts":parts[i*100:(i+1)*100]} for i in range(50)])
print('   total units', 2000*3+2000+25000)
t0=time.time(); r = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   full batch time %.2fs' % dt)
check('batch cases', len(r['cases']), 2000)
check('batch states', set(c['state'] for c in r['cases']), {'ok'})
check('batch channels', len(r['channels']), 50)
check('batch requests', sum(len(c['requests']) for c in r['channels']), 25000//len(req)*len(req) and 25000//len(req)*len(req))
check('batch error', [c['error'] for c in r['channels']], [None]*50)

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
